item.title: Ogilvy Health AI Marketing
item.description:
• Summary: A Fierce Pharma feature examines how Ogilvy Health is leveraging artificial intelligence to accelerate marketing campaigns, using nano‑influencers for targeted reach, and implementing Responsible Influencer Activation (RIA) to ensure compliance in regulated pharma marketing. The agency's perspective highlights the transformative role of AI in streamlining content creation and measuring engagement while maintaining regulatory guardrails.

item.title: AI Scientist Tools
item.description:
• Summary: A STAT News report examines the practical utility of AI scientist tools in biomedical research. The article questions whether these tools, which promise to accelerate hypothesis generation and experimental design, are delivering meaningful results in practice. It highlights challenges such as reproducibility, integration into existing workflows, and the need for rigorous validation. The piece concludes that while AI tools hold potential, their current impact is limited without proper context and domain expertise.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Quality by Design Clinical Data
item.description:
• Summary: A sponsored article from Pharmaceutical Technology discusses the challenges posed by disconnected systems in clinical data management. It advocates for a Quality by Design (QbD) approach to streamline data collection and ensure integrity. The piece emphasizes that siloed data sources can lead to inefficiencies, errors, and delays in clinical trials, and proposes integrated platforms as a solution to enhance data quality and regulatory compliance.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
